tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
Your professor,Dr.Smith,recently assigned a group project due in two weeks.You are frustrated because not all of your group members are contributing equally to the project.
Write an email to Dr.Smith.In your email,do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Describe the issue you are facing with your group members.
Describe your specific contribution to the project.
Explain why you and the group have been unable to address this issue.
tasks.subject: Issues with group project
tasks.sample:
Dear Dr. Smith,



I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to share the issue with the group project you recently assigned to us. Overall, the progress is acceptable, but two of the five group members are unwilling to complete their parts.



I talked to the two members twice about the importance of getting the full score of this project, but they still do not want to finish their part. Given the tight deadline, I need to distribute the remaining project parts to three other members, including me.



I think this issue cannot be solved because they spend most of their time doing part-time jobs outside school, and they also do not want to finish other projects assigned by other professors.



I really need your help to solve this issue my group are facing. Thank you for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you soon.



Sincerely,

Alfonso
tasks.title: Write an Email
